arguments.thoughts: Open the Condition/disease search box so I can enter 'type 2 diabetes' as the search term before applying filters.
Enter the required search term “type 2 diabetes” in the Condition/disease field to start from the correct query before applying filters.
Select the specific condition term "Type 2 Diabetes" from the suggestion list to refine the search before applying additional filters.
Study Status filter is visible; next step is to set it to Recruiting by clicking its label so the checkbox becomes checked before applying other filters.
Next, apply the Phase 3 filter by clicking its checkbox before setting location and sorting.
Open the location combobox so I can set Study Location to United States before applying filters and sorting.
Need to set the Study Location filter; typing 'United States' into the location combobox should bring up the country option to select next.
United States is typed in the location box but I must select the matching dropdown option so the filter will register and enable Apply Filters.
Apply Filters must be clicked after setting United States, Recruiting, and Phase 3 so the results list and subsequent sorting reflect all required filters.
Open the Display control to access sorting options so I can choose Last Update Posted, newest first.
Change sort from Relevance to Newest First before capturing the first three results.
Phase 3 filter is visible but unchecked; click its checkbox so the Apply Filters button will enable and Phase 3 can be applied.
Need to scroll to view the Display sort settings and the full details (NCT, status, last update) for the first three study cards after applying the Phase 3 filter.
Need to scroll back up near the top of results to locate and confirm the active Phase 3 filter and Newest First sort controls, which are currently off-screen.
Need to scroll down to see the Newest First sort control state and the full study cards, including NCT numbers, titles, status, and Last Update Posted for the first three results.

Phase 3 checkbox currently shows unchecked; I need to click this actual checkbox (not its label) so that the Phase 3 filter is visibly applied before confirming sort order and extracting the first three results.
Need to locate and confirm the Newest First sort control and Phase 3 filter state, which are likely above the currently visible study cards.
Need to reach the top of the results section to locate and adjust the sorting control to Last Update Posted, newest first, and then confirm Phase 3 filter state and capture top three cards.
Need to reach top of results list to locate and verify the sorting control (Last Update Posted, newest first) before recording first three studies.
Phase 3 checkbox currently appears unchecked; click the checkbox itself (not just label) to try to enable the Phase 3 filter so all required filters are active.
Phase 3 was just checked and filters auto-apply; now I need to scroll down to find and later adjust the sort control and verify Phase 3 is reflected in results before capturing the first three cards.
Need to locate sorting control and visible study cards with NCT, title, status, and Last Update Posted; they are likely below current viewport, so scroll down.

criterion_order: Access ClinicalTrials.gov and run search for the term "type 2 diabetes"
Apply required filters (Recruiting, Phase 3, United States)
Sort results by Last Update Posted (newest first)
Report result #1 (topmost displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
Report result #2 (second displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
Report result #3 (third displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
Follow task constraints and stopping condition

criteria.criterion: Access ClinicalTrials.gov and run search for the term "type 2 diabetes"
criteria.final_justification: DOM explicitly supports that the agent reached ClinicalTrials.gov search results for the condition Type 2 Diabetes. Baseline stands.

criteria.criterion: Apply required filters (Recruiting, Phase 3, United States)
criteria.final_justification: Recruiting and United States are clearly applied per URL/title/Search Details, but Phase 3 is not DOM-confirmed as applied. Because the criterion requires all three filters, award partial credit only for the two confirmed filters (and attempt). Baseline 4/4 is reduced.

criteria.criterion: Sort results by Last Update Posted (newest first)
criteria.final_justification: Agent action history shows an attempt to select “Newest First,” but DOM does not confirm that sorting by Last Update Posted newest-first is visibly applied. This is not an uncontrollable blocker (a Display control exists), just unverified/incomplete. Reduce from full credit to minimal partial for attempting.

criteria.criterion: Report result #1 (topmost displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not report result #1 at all (no NCT/title/status/date). Since the missing data is primarily due to the agent not completing/confirming the required filter+sort state and not extracting the fields (and no DOM-confirmed platform blocker), award 0. Baseline 4/4 was incorrect.

criteria.criterion: Report result #2 (second displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
criteria.final_justification: No reported #2 result with required fields; no confirmed blocker that makes it impossible (Display exists; titles/NCTs appear). Score 0.

criteria.criterion: Report result #3 (third displayed after filters + newest-first sort)
criteria.final_justification: No reported #3 result with required fields. Score 0.

criteria.criterion: Follow task constraints and stopping condition
criteria.final_justification: Give partial credit for respecting constraints (no prohibited actions) and not fabricating results, but deduct for failing the stopping condition/completion and making overbroad UI-impossibility claims. Reduce from 2/2 to 1/2.
